# Offline folder selection tests assert protocol-specific flags after dialog acceptance

The added test covers Local Folders, POP3, NNTP, IMAP and EWS settings. Only NNTP, IMAP and EWS select folders for offline use. Their tasks check initial folder flags, change selection with mouse and keyboard, accept the dialog, and compare the resulting Offline folder names. IMAP and EWS preserve Inbox and second while selecting third and fourth and clearing first. The historical picker mutates flags during each toggle and rolls them back on cancel. Accepted code passes one server into the picker, stages selected folders, and applies added and removed Set differences on accept. Keep these implementation phases separate when updating row expectations. The assertions prove the intended stored flag state in test source; they do not prove message downloads or restart persistence.

Scope: mail/account-settings/offline.
